Actually, the standard rule in these games is: reinforcements arrive and fight in the same turn if they are sent to a village that is attacked.
But they fight as a separate "send". So they fight the enemy troops that are attacking the village, but they don't combine with the garrison for the first fight; they fight the enemy troops after the garrison fights, or vice versa.
